Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Josiah_1: prophesied son of the house of David (1 Kings 13:2), King of Judah and son of Amon (2 Kings 21:24)
Ahab_1: son of Omri and King of Israel (1 Kings 16:28)
Hezekiah_1: King of Judah, son of Ahaz (2 Kings 16:20)
Manasseh_3: King of Judah and son of Hezekiah (2 Kings 20:21)
Uzza_1: owner of the garden where Manasseh was buried (2 Kings 21:18)
Amon_2: King of Judah and son of Manasseh (2 Kings 21:18)
Haruz_1: of Jothbah, father of Meshullemeth (2 Kings 21:19)
